ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the “Producers and Consumers” area on the left side of this food web, there is a gray fox labeled “Gray Fox” in the upper left, and below and to the left of the gray fox there is a brush mouse labeled “Brush Mouse”. In the figure, there is an arrow pointing from “Brush Mouse” to “Gray Fox”. Reasoning: According to the rule in this food web that arrows point from the organism being eaten to the predator, the Brush Mouse pointing to Gray Fox indicates that the gray fox feeds on Brush Mouse.
